title: Hagar, the Egyptian!
html_source:
Hagar was the Egyptian handmaiden of Sarai, Abraham’s wife. Sarai had been barren for a long time and sought a way to fulfill the LORD’s promise, especially since they were getting older, so she offered Hagar to Abraham “to wife”. (Genesis 16:1-3)
When Hagar realized that she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress. Sarai sensed her slave’s attitude, which caused her to suffer greatly. Sarai then consulted her husband about the matter; he gave her permission to do with Hagar as she saw fit. Sarai dealt with her harshly, which resulted in Hagar fleeing from Abraham’s settlement.(Genesis 16:4-6)
